The '''Destruction of the Pakuuni Pirates''' was a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Pakuuni Pirates]] group during the [[Battle on the Frontier]] campaign of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
The [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni system]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] had been rife with [[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|Smugglers]] rendering intergalatic trade difficult, even lethal. Having collected left over station parts from the abandoned depot at the planet [[Argoon]], [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] assigned [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Buckeye]] and [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] ''[[Ludwick]]'' the task of destroying a local [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] installation. The Pakuuni Pirates had massed a sizable armada of supplies, [[Corvette/Legends|Corvettes]], [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]], and [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]]. [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] suspected that local pirate groups had been receiving aid from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] starships; members of the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order of the Emperor]] also suggested that searching the containers may reveal contraband, consequentially requiring capture.

==The battle==
Frigate ''Ludwick'' began the assault by launching three groups of TIE Bombers. The Bombers began attacking Corvettes ''[[Leach]]'', ''[[Clavier]]'', and ''[[Grapler]]'' as pirate Z-95s and Y-wings moved to intercept. [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] group [[Theta Squadron]] was launched in response to [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] loses, more apt to dogfight with the enemies' shielded fighters. [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], flight leader of TIE bomber group [[Alpha Squadron]], swung by the pirate containers during the battle. Stele discovered Rebels hiding among one of the containers; [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|Assault Transport]] [[Tiger (Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport)|''Tiger'']] was launched from the ''[[Ludwick]]'' to capture the Rebel fugitives. As predicted Rebel starfighters arrived just as the last of the container that was carrying the Rebel Advisors was boarded and the Rebels captured, the container was destroyed. Having completed their primary mission Imperial Bombers returned to the hangar, leaving Rebel fighters to deal with interceptor craft and the ''Ludwick''{{'s}} turbolasers.

==Aftermath==
With the Pirate base destroyed the way was clear to establish a new space installation and allow commerce to flourish. The ''Ludwick'' was then assigned to hold position and wait until Thrawn arrives with the building materials.

The Secret Order, realizing that the Rebel Alliance had an extensive presence in the area began to interrogate the prisoners to learn about more information about their foothold in the Pakuuni System.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in the PC Game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]. It's the second mission of the third Battle. This article assumes "Medium" difficulty. In "Hard" Difficulty the player has to contend with [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] that will launch [[Proton rocket/Legends|Heavy rockets]] at the Ludwick and can easily deplete the ships shields and hull.
